integrity: A symbolic proof establishes all stated quantifiers and asymptotics; an accompanying reproducible finite exact-arithmetic checker supplements but does not replace the proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The inverse-covariance statement concerns full-order linear partial correlations, not conditional independence or causality. A sharp asymptotic transition is proved for homogeneous triangle layers with m/n tending to a strictly positive constant; no finite-size critical sign or heterogeneous-layer theorem is claimed. Historical priority is subject to independent literature review.
title: A four-thirds linear-partial-correlation transition in random triangle overlays
